name: Akabane Reiji
source:
Chiaki's husband.

Although he married Chiaki because he was going to be serious, his job didn't last long and he is now unemployed.

He rarely works, loves to gamble, and is often away from home. He is often depressed when his wife lectures him, but the next day, he is fine.

[From [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc074/character.html]official site[/url]]
